english.title: Make a false representation / fraudulently do / omit to do a thing for the purpose of obtaining approval of creditors
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a debtor

(A)_[made a false representation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE REPRESENTATION..),]_
(B)_[fraudulently did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..),]_
(C)_[fraudulently omitted to do an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT OMITTED..),]_

for the purpose of obtaining the approval of your creditors to a proposal for a voluntary arrangement under section 263D of the Insolvency act 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to section 262A of the Insolvency Act 1986.
